A business development company, such as the Company ("BDC"), may not acquire any asset other than a qualifying asset...

findings.detail: Vehicle type BDC drove PRIVATE_CREDIT strategy even though the filer composition shows credit-like assets of only $5,594,413, or 14.9% of $37,591,400 total invested assets.

rationale: Raw source confirms NexPoint is a BDC, but the filing's own December 31, 2025 portfolio composition does not support a PRIVATE_CREDIT strategy assignment from vehicle type alone: senior secured loans are $5,339,307 (14.2%) and corporate bonds are $255,106 (0.7%), totaling $5,594,413, while total invested assets are $37,591,400. Common stocks and preferred stock together are 62.2% of fair value, so the fund_strategy_validation flag reflects a real strategy classification/lookthrough defect rather than a false alarm.
